info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Foreign Exchange Trades Management API
info.description: The Foreign Exchange Trades Management API enables businesses to initiate and manage foreign exchange trades for their customers. With this API, financial institutions can submit trade requests that reflect current market conditions and client needs. Typical consumers of this API include banking and investment firms looking to streamline their foreign exchange operations. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance their trading efficiency and improve customer service through timely execution of transactions.

post.summary: Create a new foreign exchange trade for a specific customer.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new foreign exchange trade for the customer with the given ID. Ensure that all required fields are populated in the request body to successfully create a trade.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new foreign exchange trade for the specified customer. It should contain all necessary details regarding the trade such as currency pairs, amounts, and timestamps.

201.description: The foreign exchange trade was created successfully.
